subject: Request: Extend 21-day trial with surge-protection addendum
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@sigiltech.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood-inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sigiltech.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Extend 21-day trial with surge-protection addendum

Hi Aisha / Connor,

Quick one from our side — we're coming up on the 21-day evaluation window for the Redwood trial and would like to request a short extension while we validate the final throughput scenarios. The ask: 3 additional weeks (21 days) and the ability to add a short-term surge-protection layer to cover predicted spikes while we ramp.

Key constraints from procurement:
- We need commercial language and a quote by EOD Fri, Jun 25 so our internal approvers can move this through.
- Preferred billing: invoice, Net 30.

Can you outline options (pricing delta, how it affects go-live credits, and what the SOW/AMENDMENT looks like)? Two things we'd like to evaluate:
- A credit-based top-up for 21 days (prepaid, one-off)
- A temporary surge-protection addendum (retainer for guaranteed burst capacity)

Thanks — if we can get two clear options and the contract attachments we can greenlight quickly.

Liam
Liam Carter
Senior Product Manager — SigilTech
liam.carter@sigiltech.com
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@sigiltech.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Extend 21-day trial with surge-protection addendum

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear ask. Below are two concrete options and the commercial impact for SigilTech. I've attached a short quote (extension_quote_SIG-2026-41.pdf) that mirrors Option A and a redline-ready SOW template if you want the surge addendum spelled into an amendment.

Option A — 21-day credit top-up (recommended for minimal contract churn)
- Prepaid credit for 21 days equivalent to your current observed burn rate x 3 weeks.
- One-time 25% discount off list token rates for the extension credit.
- No change to existing SOW; we issue a one-line invoice referencing SIG-2026-41.
- Billing: invoice Net 30 (we can accomodate).
- Time to execute: < 24 hours after signature + payment.

Option B — 21-day surge-protection addendum (reserved buffer)
- 2-hour guaranteed burst capacity pool with guaranteed pre-warm for the evaluation window.
- Monthly retainer: $6,000 for the 21-day period (pro-rated), covers reservation + higher SLA for ephemeral capacity.
- Addendum amends SOW; requires countersignature (DocuSign link below).
- Billing: retainer invoiced upfront; Net 30.

Notes and tradeoffs:
- Option A keeps procurement simple (single invoice, no SOW changes).
- Option B gives you capacity guarantees and reduces throttling risk during heavy load tests, but it does require an amendment and a slightly higher up-front cost.

Attachments included: extension_quote_SIG-2026-41.pdf (quote showing both options), draft addendum outline.

Next steps:
1) Tell us which option you prefer.
2) If A, we'll issue the quote and invoice immediately for Net 30.
3) If B, we'll route the addendum via DocuSign and coordinate billing.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: aisha.rahman@redwood-inference.com
Direct: (415) 555-0172

Aisha — thanks for the quick options. Procurement and I reviewed overnight. We'd like to move forward with Option A (credit top-up) but need two adjustments to proceed quickly:

1) Can you stretch the extension discount to 30%? Our budget owner is pushing for a stronger concession to cover validation work.
2) We have ~5 unused days left on the current trial window; can these be converted to credit and applied against the new invoice?

If you can confirm those two points and send the updated invoice/quote with Net 30, Procurement will route for approval. We prefer to keep things simple and avoid SOW changes for now.

Liam

--
Liam Carter
Senior Product Manager — SigilTech

Hi Liam / Procurement team —

Thanks for the clarity. We can do the following to keep this moving and honor SigilTech's evaluation needs:

Final revised commercial (Option A - Revised)
- 21-day credit top-up at 30% off list token rates (approved internally for this case).
- Apply a prorated credit for the ~5 unused trial days against the new invoice (line item: Prorated unused trial credit).
- Invoice terms: Net 30 (as requested).
- Total due and invoice will reference deal ID SIG-2026-41.

Attachments and links:
- SOW_SigilTech_21d_extension.docx (attachment) — amendment template if you later want to convert to a formal addendum.
- DocuSign (if you want a signature-based amendment): https://redwood-inference.app/docusign/SIG-2026-41
